context.requirement_text: REQ-204: SSRF validation for webhook target_url. 9 acceptance criteria: (1) non-https scheme rejection at create/2; (2) 5 explicit private-range rejections at create/2 (127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254, 10.0.0.5, 172.16.0.5, 192.168.0.5); (3) legitimate https target succeeds at create/2; (4) deliver/3 DNS-rebinding test (hostname resolves to private IP at delivery time); (5) dispatch_http/3 no-redirect regression; (6) INV-9 added (already done); (7) moduledoc ranges (already done); (8) mix test passes; (9) no scope change.

task.description: Write tests for REQ-204 SSRF validation. Required test files: (1) test/letflow/webhooks/url_validator_test.exs -- unit tests for UrlValidator directly; (2) additions to test/letflow/webhooks_test.exs -- integration tests for create/2 and deliver/3 SSRF paths. See design §6 for the DNS injection hook mechanism. All 9 acceptance criteria must have test coverage.
acceptance_criteria: test/letflow/webhooks/url_validator_test.exs exists with unit tests for all range checks
AC1: create/2 with http:// scheme rejected with {:error, :target_url_not_allowed}
AC3: create/2 with legitimate https target succeeds
AC4: DNS rebinding test -- deliver/3 refuses when hostname resolves to private IP at delivery time
AC5: dispatch_http/3 does not auto-follow 3xx (no {autoredirect, true} in HTTPOptions)
Tests use the dns_resolver injection hook (validate/2) for unit tests, not real DNS

tests: url_validator: IPv4 link-local / cloud metadata 169.254.169.254 is rejected by name
url_validator: IPv6 ULA fc00::1 is rejected (fc00::/7)
url_validator: IPv6 link-local fe80::1 is rejected (fe80::/10, REVIEWER OQ-1)
url_validator: hostname resolving to public IP via injected resolver is allowed
url_validator: public IP literal (no DNS needed) is allowed
url_validator: hostname resolving to 169.254.169.254 at validation time is rejected (DNS rebinding)
url_validator: hostname resolving to loopback 127.0.0.1 via injected resolver is rejected
url_validator: hostname resolving to private RFC-1918 via injected resolver is rejected
url_validator: DNS NXDOMAIN is treated as blocked
url_validator: DNS timeout is treated as blocked
webhooks AC1: http:// scheme rejected with {:error, :target_url_not_allowed}
webhooks AC3: https target with public IP literal creates the subscription and returns hmac_secret_once
webhooks AC4 (slow ~9s): deliver/3 records FAILED attempts and does not POST when target_url is private at dispatch time
webhooks AC5: dispatch_http/3 does not pass autoredirect: true or follow_redirect: true to :httpc
result.run_counts: 21/21 url_validator, 26/26 webhooks_test (1 excluded by default -- @tag timeout:30000 -- passes when included)

side_effects.create_helper_updated: test/letflow/webhooks_test.exs create!/2 helper changed from 'https://example.test/hook' to 'https://93.184.216.34/hook' -- REQ-204 blocks .test TLD (NXDOMAIN = blocked per OQ-3); without this fix 14 pre-existing tests would fail
side_effects.regression_noted_in_spec: test/specs/REQ-204.md documents that Letflow.WebhooksDeliveryTest (REQ-183) is broken: WebhookTestServer returns http://127.0.0.1:PORT/hook which is now rejected by SSRF validation at create/2 time. 5/7 REQ-183 tests fail. This is a gap in ELIXIR-DEV's implementation that ORCH/ISSUE-FIXER should address.
